x: Megaphone Man " Cook."—Not liking Redcaps has transferred to the R.A.S.C., and is now in Dorset. Colin Sutton, from whom a very long and interesting letter has been received from Medicine Hat, has gained his Wings and hopes to be home again very shortly.
Megaphone Man Cook, writing from Blandford, Dorset, sends his regards to all his old friends, and hopes to see us at Christmas.
